limits: All searches remain local and bounded; no universal theorem follows.
All octahedral facet incidences are re-enumerated from halfspaces after optimization.
Tolerance stress is numerical evidence; its nonzero allowed residual prevents an exact positivity inference.
protocol: Two bounded starts per asymmetric original family and regular/asymmetric octahedron; same incidence verification and dominance conventions as controls.py

asymmetric_cube.mechanism: unit facet normals at fixed positive support values; full stable incidence chamber

asymmetric_octahedron.mechanism: six independently movable vertices; eight triangular supporting facets; every octahedron vertex is nonsimple

asymmetric_pentagonal_prism.mechanism: unit facet normals at fixed positive support values; full stable incidence chamber

asymmetric_pyramid_4.mechanism: convex planar n-gon and an apex of height one; all side planes concurrent

asymmetric_pyramid_5.mechanism: convex planar n-gon and an apex of height one; all side planes concurrent

asymmetric_pyramid_8.mechanism: convex planar n-gon and an apex of height one; all side planes concurrent

asymmetric_tetrahedron.mechanism: unit facet normals at fixed positive support values; full stable incidence chamber

asymmetric_triangular_prism.mechanism: unit facet normals at fixed positive support values; full stable incidence chamber

asymmetric_truncated_cube.mechanism: unit facet normals at fixed positive support values; full stable incidence chamber

octahedron.mechanism: six independently movable vertices; eight triangular supporting facets; every octahedron vertex is nonsimple
